THE TREASURER’S OFFICE WILL NOT BE HELD RESPONSIBLE IF YOU DO NOT HAVE YOUR TAX STATEMENT OR A TOTAL WITH YOU TO MAKE PAYMENTS. IF THERE IS A PARCEL THAT GOES UNPAID IT IS THE TAXPAYER’S RESPONSIBILITY AND DOES NOT LIE ON THE RESPONSIBILITY OF THE OFFICE EMPLOYEES.
|
Collection dates and Payment options:
Property tax statements will be mailed by mid-April each year.
Typically, tax payments are due May 10th and November 10th of each year.
Accepted Forms of Payment:
By Mail:
Morgan County Treasurer
180 S. Main St., Ste 129
Martinsville, IN 46151
* Make sure to send A and/or B coupons with payment. Must be postmarked by USPS by the due date to be considered on time.
Drop Box:
A Drop Box is available at all times and days in the alley off Columbus Street, behind CrossFit Fitness. Additionally, Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM, a Drop Box is located outside the Treasurer's Office inside the Administration Building.

By Phone: 1-877-690-3729, Jurisdiction Code 2405. Parcel Number is required.

Convenience Fees:
Electronic Check - $2.00
Visa Debit Cards - $4.00
Other Credit and Debit Cards - 2.55% of the payment amount with a minimum service fee of $2.00
General Information:
Morgan County Innkeeper’s tax remains due and payable by the 20th of each month.
Property Tax Clearance Form requests may be made in person, by mail, or by email to treasure@morgancounty.in.gov
Mobile Home Permit request should first call or email for further instruction at 765-342-1048 or treasure@morgancounty.in.gov
A $15.00 service fee applies to all Mobile Home transfers and moving permits. Payment accepted by cash or check only.
Property Taxes
Property tax is a complex process due to strict laws and the segregation of duties. Three departments work together to complete the process.
Simplified, the process unfolds as follows:
Assessor’s Office: places an Assessment value on the property. The taxpayer’s right to appeal an assessment can be found at IC 6-1.1-15. email - assessor@morgancounty.in.gov
Auditor’s Office: applies the deductions, exemptions, and calculates the tax amount. No deduction is automatic and various restrictions apply. Information on deductions can be found at 6-1.1
Email – auditor@morgancounty.in.gov
Treasurer’s Office: bills and collects the taxes. You cannot appeal the dollar amount of your taxes, but you can appeal the assessment with the Assessor’s Office and verify with the Auditor’s Office that the deductions have been applied.
Email – treasure@morgancounty.in.gov
